arc: Little follows folding commands, discovers that water supports the boat, tests a penny load, then sees swamping and soaking reveal why a paper voyage cannot last forever.
choices: One ivory open boat, one blue-gray tub, copper pennies throughout.
Warm paper and ink with rare gold; calm editorial composition.
Big and Little are the same nonhuman pebble guides as morning dew.
No embedded text or answer diagrams; story and code supply the mechanism.

plates.intent: Establish a flat ivory sheet, tub, pennies, and Little’s question about carrying a load.
Show deliberate folding in sequence, open walls and broad bottom; a program-like list of commands.
Reveal the boat afloat in the tub, with the water’s upward push explained in prose.
Compare the same boat under a small penny load: lower hull and higher waterline.
Show water entering over an overloaded rim: a finite limit, not a magic floating material.
End with damp sagging paper and saved commands; connect absorb to plant fibers and a new question.
